name: 旧木地面
prompt: Create ONE square opaque seamless material texture filling every pixel. Reference 1 and 2 are approved final hand-painted environment materials; match broad brush-shaped masses and restrained contrast. Other refs guide painted contours and volume but DO NOT draw any prop or character. Salvaged wide dull brown plank flooring, irregular plank lengths, dark seams, localized scuffing and one replaced pale board. Flat top-down rectangular texture, long plank axes parallel to image vertical. Orthographic flat material swatch; NO isometric diamond, camera perspective, pedestal, lighting gradient, border, transparent area, text, rendered room, object shadow, photoreal micro-noise or PBR specular. Large readable painted shapes; visible but subdued wear, not neat showroom. Edges should tile or mirror smoothly.
